notes.title: Update: "Rise of the first father"
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

A new update is up, it is way more balanced as the first version seems it have been too hard, even felix complained.


In "The rise of the first father" you have to fight your way as 'Rudolf I' from 'The Habichtsburg' to 'Vienna'. You play against the other classes, which you know if you are a VEmpire fan are stronger than Rudolf I.
If you win in one location you have the corresponding location card as reward in the next place! are you tough enough? 

btw: felix is already in triest, so hurry up guys!

cheers, yours wulf![img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30269409/0cf04a5d7775d7600495199fed20235d65b7035f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Sorry for the silence, new update comes soon!
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

I am really sorry for the silence here on steam, but some of you might know
that we are busy preparing the upcoming iOS version of VEmpire.

Anyway a lot of good things and improvements have found the way into the game.
Most things however are in the background about stability and robustness.

The feature i like the most and came from a mobile VEmpire player is the Mercenary Sum. This is just, to save space, Mercenaries are aggregated in the empire, so that there is just one card visible with the number of the amount on top.
Simple, but a great improvement regarding clarity.

So stay tuned, the update comes soon, and please keep the fingers crossed
for the app-review by apple.

cheers, yours wolf!

notes.title: Next update comes this week!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

During testing "cross-platform" with iOS we've detected some nasty bugs.
The good news: we "have" them , they just need to be fixed, but wisely...

So expect an update in the next day(s)!

As i've promised, the work on mobile and testing "cross-platform" will improve the quality of the game!
This have not been just words as we see now!

Also we never thought of different scenarios of "bad" connection in PvP which really is an issue with mobile, so we are also improving the game to be much more stable in situations
where connection get's lost or times out or whatever...

cheers, wolf...

PS: if anyone want's to test on iOS, would be great to have one from you guys!
Android: a little later!

notes.title: UPDATE IS UP [StartDecks & +1Attack if Attacks are empty!]
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

I've switched the update to "live"!

the major things beside bug-fixes and smaller things are:

- choose different startdecks, in PvP the first one chooses!!!
  vs. AI you can always choose it!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30269409/f6f40ae1495c8de4885a0316413bc88224c13687.png[/img]

- if the attack cards are gone you have +1 attack static!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30269409/6d6e5358c016b28324abf3025f29f063ff961d08.png[/img]


- you can now cancel banish, clone, revive cards, this means if you 'leave' they go into your discard-pile, not into the graveyard!


you can have much faster and intense games now.
try the deck with the locations first, this with the static +1 attack, i love it,
it's awesome to throw those huge attacks against your opponent!

please alarm me if there is an issue with the version!
love to have your feedback!

cheers, wolf...

let's go!!! :-)

curious about your opinion on this!

notes.title: VEmpire Early Access Release Statement!
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

It has been a long journey until here, some of you are new, and some of you are with us from the beginning!
VEmpire is our “baby” since 4 years now, but now it is the time to let it be “our” baby to stay with this metaphor!

We have made this game for you, it is nothing without the fanbase!
We would love if you help us to build up a strong and loyal community around the game. 
But even more we want to hear and listen to your feedback. We want to improve and extend the game together with you. Let’s discuss whatever it might be around VEmpire here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/619230/discussions/

We know VEmpire is a niche game, and maybe it will stay there. There are thousands of games out there but we hope we’ve created something special and you will enjoy the experience.

Last but not least: 
Unfortunately I see a lot of disrespect and hate on comments & reviews on steam. You might love or even hate the game, but please always stay respectful, and keep in mind that a lot of people already share a lot of passion for the game.

 
Much love, Wolfgang!

notes.title: Preview: the upcoming EA-Version of VEmpire!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

The last weeks we've highly focused on the game-mechanics & game-play of VEmpire.
Although we loved it as it was, we wanted it to be more "accessible"!
But this does not mean that it will become more casual or simpler but decide for yourself, just very roughly the main changes:

- It is not to collect 50 points first to win anymore!
- Both player start with a certain amount of empire-points, and it is your goal to knock down your opponent to zero first, to win!
- Therefore we'll introduce "attacking" as new mechanic!
- So there will be a new type of cards: attack-cards, which can also be used to buy better cards just like empire-cards, but in opposite to empire-cards which are gone once they are played into the empire, they can be used for attacking again because they are drawn again!
- Blocking: this is so awesome because it just works in your hand! This means: if your hand contains blocking cards they defend attacking-points, but: your opponent do not see them!!!! Every time they are drawn the blocking power is refreshed!

This are the planned main-changes which are....
...awesome!!! as far as we've tried it until now....

I truly believe that VEmpire brings so many new mechanics into the genre!
It is not a hearthstone-like game as 99% of the card-games out there!
With the newest additions it will bring much more interaction into the genre of deck building also!
Additionally, we have so many plans to improve the game-genre even more in the future: e.g. "Cooperative Buying" etc... 
But all this needs really a lot of time to work properly, so I realized that patience is very important, not only for you guys, but also for us developers.
At least as it is with us: we can not rush it!

It is enough for now, please let us know what you think, and do not hesitate to ask: whatever...

cheers, wolfgang!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30269409/3212d225bc58535098c9cdddd57b3ca3fdda7184.jpg[/img]

thanks &
